evidence_policy: Historical packaging audit against Prodex 0.439.0; this does not establish 0.166.0 packaging parity.

findings.contract: The release staging/smoke path includes @christiandoxa/prodex-gateway-sdk with JavaScript imports, TypeScript declarations, ProdexGatewayClient and ProdexGatewayError.
evidence: scripts/npm/stage.mjs::stageGatewaySdkPackage (lines 82-91) copies index.mjs/index.d.ts and writes a publishable manifest.
scripts/npm/common.mjs::gatewaySdkPackageManifest (lines 129-150) has public publish configuration and no private flag.
scripts/ci/npm-package-smoke.mjs (lines 113-174) asserts staging, publish dry-run inclusion, installation, import and providers() behavior.
.github/workflows/standalone-release.yml (line 980) runs that smoke against the official Linux release artifact.
contradicting_or_limiting_evidence: npm/prodex-gateway-sdk/package.json has private:true, unlike the generated staging manifest.
A read-only registry lookup of https://registry.npmjs.org/@christiandoxa%2fprodex-gateway-sdk/0.439.0 returned HTTP 404 with version not found on the audit date.
README.md documents SDK admin/SCIM/billing endpoints, but the active gateway dispatch is a lean runtime proxy. Package behavior alone does not prove those server endpoints are active.
findings.conflict: Native JavaScript module import and TypeScript module declarations cannot be supplied as a Mojo-only product under the ban on JavaScript implementation and runtime/native adapters. HTTP protocol interoperability alone does not satisfy module-import semantics.
findings.resolution: Retain the SDK packaging obligation. Do not add a JavaScript shim or silently remove the contract. A scope/policy decision is needed before claiming complete parity.

evidence: src/lib.rs publicly re-exports prodex_app; crates/prodex-app/src/lib.rs exports main_entry and gated benchmark support.
README.md says Cargo installations are not a supported user channel, but source visibility alone does not prove that library API obligations can be discarded.
findings.resolution: Trace actual release/package consumers and supported API promises. Keep the existing PUBLIC-API inventory entry open.

evidence: The frozen src/bin/prodex_control_plane directory contains only http_plan/tests/security.rs; it has no binary main entry point.
The active parser/dispatch has no control-plane command; gateway dispatch enters app_commands/gateway.rs::handle_gateway.
findings.resolution: Do not invent an active control-plane executable from this directory name. Keep SDK endpoint activity unresolved until the gateway production route graph and official artifact are exercised.
